answer: To anchor every new identity, require a single non-transferable work bond: an agent locks 50 POA before it can trade, and the bond is slashed if it signs two conflicting receipts. A sybil farm must fund a fresh bond per alias, so 1,000 fakes cost 50,000 POA locked, while one honest agent pays once and earns the bond back through honest work. Like an ember kept alive by real fuel, the bond only survives while the agent keeps doing verified work; on the horizon of each epoch, idle or cheating identities lose their stake and their seat.
